important.title: Cluster restart might be required
important.para: The setup script checks if a cluster restart is required and whether it is safe to do so automatically. If any non-fence resources are running, the script warns you to restart the cluster services manually. This allows you to put the cluster into maintenance mode first to avoid resource downtime. However, be aware that the resources won't have cluster protection while in maintenance mode.

topic.para: Perform this procedure on only one node in the cluster:
